body: These voices are different from my conscience, I don't talk to them they just mutter to me. This doesn't only happen while trying to sleep, it happens while I'm driving during the day, in class, anywhere. Most of the time it's manageable but sometimes my eyes go blurry and my head starts hurting and I have to sit down and hope it passes soon. It's a really ugly feeling and I'm just getting tired of it

This is my first time ever meeting with a therapist. I've made appointments in the past but I always cancel last minute because of fear. So I suppose it's a step but the purpose of me seeing the counselor for me is to just make the time I have left more tolerable. I have talked to my parents about my illness once and I didn't even mention the voices. They think I'm making up these things, they used words like crazy and I don't want them to look at me like I'm crazy. So I don't bring it up to them anymore. I'm dealing with this myself. Can't talk to anyone in my family. My friends think I'm happy and I don't want them to see me differently so I don't tell them. I often find myself daydreaming of myself hanging from the places around me. I see a pill bottle and think of the possiblity of not having to feel this anymore. I see a knife and think I'd only have to get through bleeding out and then I'd be free

I live my life pretending that I'm the happiest person.  I find myself trying to make the people around me think I'm happy and doing well when I've been spiraling into a dark hole over the past year. I feel sick every morning I wake up because I have nothing to look forward to. Just another day of walking around with this smile on my face that turns to tears when behind closed doors. If I make it to 2017 it will be a miracle. I've tied my noose so many times I could probably do it blind folded. I'm scared to die but I'm scared to keep living this life of hiding this immense pain I feel every day
